title: OTCP method schema file
description: Shape of methods/<method>.schema.json (methods/README.md). Each method file is itself a JSON Schema 2020-12 document whose $defs hold params and result, plus the x-otcp annotation with the method's metadata.

jobResult.description: Result of the job the method starts (job.result), for methods whose startsJob is not null.

write.description: yes: changes project, content, file or preference state. conditional: changes state only for some params or as a reported side effect. no: never changes such state.

resultKind.description: write: the result extends the write envelope. read: the result carries asOf and derived. plain: neither.

startsJob.description: Job kind the method may start, or null.

requiresSession.description: false only for session.hello, which is sent before authentication.

mainThread.description: true when the method runs on OpenTune's main thread and may therefore return TIMEOUT(dispatch_timeout) (PROTOCOL.md section 13).

errors.description: Every error kind the method may return, including the generic ones (methods/README.md): INVALID_ARGUMENT, BUSY, SHUTTING_DOWN and INTERNAL always; UNSUPPORTED unless the capability is session.v1; TIMEOUT exactly when mainThread is true.

jobErrors.description: Every error kind that a job the method starts may end with (job.error): INTERNAL always, CANCELLED when the job kind can be cancelled, and the kinds the job itself can produce (methods/README.md). Present exactly when startsJob is not null.

valueCapabilities.description: Values of top-level params members that need a capability besides capability: maps the member name to an object that maps each such value to the capability it needs (PROTOCOL.md section 3.3 rule 5 case 10). Absent when no value needs one.
